CustomField.formula:
IF(
LicenseType__r.WallCertInclDateinMiddleVerbiage__c = true,
TEXT(DAY(OriginalDateofLicensure__c))
+
(CASE(DAY(OriginalDateofLicensure__c), 1, "st", 2, "nd", 3, "rd", 21, "st", 22, "nd", 23, "rd", "th"))
+ " Day of " +
(CASE(MONTH(OriginalDateofLicensure__c), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "none"))
+ ", A.D "
+ TEXT(YEAR(OriginalDateofLicensure__c))
,
null)
CustomField.label: Wall Cert Middle Date
